notes: The manual does not name the Raspberry Pi model. raspberry-pi-3b is assumed, with the 3V3 wire on 3V3.1 and the GND wire on GND.1.
The resistor value is not given. 220 ohm is assumed as a typical LED current-limiting value.

Layout: the 'left side of the ravine' is taken as the top bank (t) and the other side as the bottom bank (b). The manual's 'row 1' is column 1 in the catalogue naming. The LED anode is at 1t.a and the cathode at 1b.f.
The resistor leg 1 is at 1b.g, in the same strip as the LED cathode. Its other leg is at 5b.g, a free column on the same side.
The 3V3 wire's male end is at 1t.b, in the same strip as the LED anode. The GND wire's male end is at 5b.h, in the same strip as the resistor's second leg.
On jumper-wire-mf, port a is taken as the male end (into the breadboard) and port b as the female end (onto the Pi header pin).
Current path: 3V3 -> wire1 -> LED anode -> LED cathode -> resistor -> wire2 -> GND. The LED is the right way round: anode to 3V3, cathode to the resistor and GND.
